description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of tokens and Macro-F1 Score. The x-axis is labeled "Number of tokens", has a linear scale, ranges from 0.5 to 1.5, and has tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis is labeled "Macro-F1 Score (%)", has a linear scale, ranges from 48 to 58, and has tick labels at intervals of 2. 

The first line, colored pink, is labeled "MATTER (ours)" and is represented by circular markers connected by a solid line. It begins at approximately 54.5 at x=0.5, increases to a peak of approximately 57.2 at x=1.0, then declines to approximately 52.5 at x=1.5. A shaded region surrounds the line, indicating a range of values. The second line, colored purple, is labeled "w/o material information" and is represented by circular markers connected by a solid line. It begins at approximately 52.2 at x=0.5, remains relatively steady around 53.0 between x=0.6 and x=1.2, and then declines sharply to approximately 48.5 at x=1.5. A shaded region surrounds this line as well, indicating a range of values.
